name: Email a weekly report of every active Argorant campaign

parameters.content:
## Email a weekly report of every active Argorant campaign

### How it works
One email on Monday morning with the numbers that matter. The workflow lists your active campaigns, reads the last 7 days of each one and builds a table: emails sent, replies, reply rate, positive replies and bounce rate. The reply rate counts every reply, out of office included, as Argorant reports it. Campaigns with a bounce rate above the limit in Settings are flagged so you check their mailboxes and lists.

No credits are used and no webhooks are needed, so it works on every plan.

### Setup
1. Install the community node **n8n-nodes-argorant** (tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.46.6): Settings > Community nodes > Install. Guide: https://github.com/argorant/n8n-nodes-argorant
2. Add an **Argorant API** credential with a key from Argorant (Settings, API keys).
3. Put the recipient and the bounce limit into **Settings**.
4. Add a Gmail credential to **Email the report** and activate.

### Customization
Change the window in **Last 7 days**, or post the table to your team chat.

## Numbers
Seven days of results for every active campaign.

## Report
One table, flags above your bounce limit.
